::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 15th Aug. 1867.  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1): P. 469
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
The end of the [M.S](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd). reached [me](people/person_379.qmd) with your letter. I at once sent it to the Printer. Whatever alteration you may wish to make either in [*illegible*] or modifying can be done in the proof.

[Miss Martin](people/person_971.qmd) - whom I saw yesterday - agreed with me in this.

Yours very [*illegible*]
Geo Lillie Craik

---

**Note:** Frances Martin was the editor of [Macmillan's Sunday Library](organizations/other_145.qmd), in which CMY's *The Pupils of St. John the Divine* was going to appear.
